Parents who choose Devika usually hope their child will grow to embody god's greatness and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Therefore, Devika holds a deep connection with both the Judeo-Christian and Hindu traditions.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Devika holds immense spiritual significance, as it is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Devi,' which signifies goddess. This spiritual significance is a powerful reminder of the connection between the human experience and the divine, encouraging faith, hope, and devotion.
